note: Baseline for docs/plans/cai-owns-its-pages.md Phase 2. Images live outside the repository, at ~/Hentet/kennel/cai-owns-its-pages/baseline/ (89 MiB) — this manifest is the committed artefact and records the sha256 of each. ★★ WHAT CAN AND CANNOT BE PIXEL-COMPARED. A survey portrait is pinned to a commit and a rubric version, both recorded below, so the same inputs can be replayed and the render compared pixel for pixel. An AGGREGATE page — the corpus index, a language, package, country or advisory page — is a reading over the whole corpus on the day it was taken, and the corpus changes daily: those pages will differ between any two captures for reasons that have nothing to do with who composed them. They are verified by the node-tree diff over a frozen dataset, not by the pixel gate. Saying so here rather than discovering it as a wall of red in phase 6.
